extracted.name: Whole Wheat Banana Bread
extracted.description: big hit with the Fam! fluffy:)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a loaf pan.
Mash bananas in a bowl. Add melted butter and mix well.
Stir in sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract until combined.
In another bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, and salt.
Add dry ingredients to wet mixture. Stir until just combined.
Pour batter into loaf pan. Smooth the top.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
